opening.argument: The video presents a disclosed referral-credit arrangement tied to ordinary DoorDash promotion, not an unsupported promise of payment or hidden destination. It identifies the activity as being a DoorDash affiliate, explains that users receive credits for promoting their own promo code, and gives concrete steps to obtain and share the link. The process includes using Bitly and locating people seeking DoorDash credits, while the description expressly states that the links are affiliate links and that both parties receive a bonus when they are used. The displayed DoorDash screen reinforces the stated offer with “Give $20, Get $20” and a “SHARE YOUR LINK” section. Although the presentation uses promotional earnings language, the available evidence does not establish deception, a different link destination, or any outcome beyond using obtained credits for a pickup order.
